audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer chart gives Gangplank five of seven stages at 8/10 and the content chart gives him five as well, in a matchup Gangplank wins 48.29% of the time over 1172 games. The prose on the same page disagrees with the chart at almost every row: whys[0] says Tryndamere free-hits the keg and out-trades the autos, whys[2] says his Spinning Slash jumps you the moment you step up, whys[4] says Undying Rage survives a full keg chain, whys[5] says 'he wins the prolonged late 1v1', and whys[6] says the late game is a map-reading contest rather than a lane win. The packet chart (Tryndamere/Gangplank/Tryndamere/Skill/Tryndamere/Tryndamere/Skill) matches the prose row for row.
audit.why: Gangplank's only owned stage is the level-6 Cannon Barrage window; everything else is either Tryndamere's or a coin-flip, which is what a sub-50% win rate should look like.
audit.corrected: Both charts set to Tryndamere/Gangplank/Tryndamere/Skill/Tryndamere/Tryndamere/Skill with ratings dropped to match, and report[14].t corrected from 'Tricky' to 'Hard' so it agrees with diff=HARD.

audit.why: Spikes are accurate: Tryndamere's level 1-3 keg denial, Gangplank's level-6 Cannon Barrage swing, the Sheen window blunted by Undying Rage, and the late splitpush-versus-global contest. Four entries present.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer names only Undying Rage and gives it no cooldown. It never names Spinning Slash, Bloodlust or Battle Fury, and it misses the one mechanic that changes how you retreat: Mocking Shout only slows enemies whose BACKS ARE TURNED to Tryndamere. Running straight away from him is the exact input that applies the slow.
audit.why: Riot text, Mocking Shout (W): 'decreasing surrounding champions' Attack Damage. Enemies with their backs turned to Tryndamere also have their Move Speed reduced.' 14s flat, 850 range. Spinning Slash (E) is 12/11/10/9/8 at 650 range and targets a unit, so he can also spin off minions. Bloodlust (Q) is 12s and consumes Fury to heal. Undying Rage (R) is 120/100/80.
audit.corrected: Mocking Shout's back-turned condition stated; Undying Rage and Spinning Slash given their cooldowns; Bloodlust named as the healing that anti-heal answers.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers in the full layer despite three sequencing cues in the packet.
audit.why: Undying Rage at 120s rank 1 is the long bait window; Spinning Slash at 12s rank 1 is the one that decides whether you can step up at all.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[9].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page says 'anti-heal his crits' without naming the healing ability.
audit.why: Bloodlust (Q) consumes Fury to heal on a 12s cooldown — that is the sustain Grievous Wounds has to answer, not the crits themselves.

notes: suspectNames flagged 'Powder Kegs', 'Save Cannon Barrage' and "Cannon Barrage's" — all three are false positives.
